about: Experience faster, deeper and more intense moment-to-moment match action on the field, with a variety of game modes for all you rookie players and returning seasoned vets.
• Lead your Ballplayer to Road to the Show and Diamond Dynasty glory as a two-way star.
• Enjoy updates to Franchise and March to October modes which empower you to better make decisions for the future of your club.
• Face your friends on PS4™ or PS5™ with cross-platform play*
